title: Scheme descent data and local representability on a covering family
statement: Let $T$ and $U_i$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $f_i:U_i\to T$ be a set-indexed family, in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the big fppf slice sites [def-pc-fppf-site] and their sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. A family scheme descent datum is a family of schemes $X_i/U_i$ and overlap isomorphisms over $U_i\times_T U_j$ satisfying the triple-overlap cocycle, with fibre products as in [def-pc-fibre-product]. Encode it through Yoneda by local sheaves $F_i$, specified natural representing bijections $\operatorname{Mor}_{U_i}(-,X_i)\cong F_i$, and Mathlib's natural descent transitions between their slice restrictions, with identity and cocycle. The category has compatible local sheaf maps as morphisms, which by Yoneda are exactly the compatible local scheme maps; its forgetful functor remembers the sheaf descent datum. In the covering-family form of [def-pd-descent-datum], define effectivity geometrically: there exist $X/T$ and maps $q_i:X_i\to X$ such that each square $(q_i,X_i\to U_i,X\to T,f_i)$ is Cartesian and transport on all overlap test points preserves the composite to $X$. Define the full-subcategory predicate of locally representable fppf sheaves $H$ by requiring each restriction $H|_{U_i}$ to be representable; equivalently, each $h_{U_i}\times H$ is representable.
